mapper.sql: id, member_id, schedule_id, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalEnrollments, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as todayEnrollments, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as weekEnrollments FROM gym_course_enrollment WHERE deleted = 0
